The plate looks like a square side plate of about 24 cm. The rice pile covers roughly 9 cm by 8 cm and is perhaps 2 cm high at its peak. That works out to about 100 g of cooked rice, which is roughly 130 kcal per 100 g, so about 130 kcal. A few scattered grains and a little oil or sauce residue add a small amount, bringing the total to about 110 g and 145 kcal.
